content.rendered:
How Can I Help You?

I am committed to providing quality customer service while getting to know our customer members. I offer assistance with account opening and maintenance, residential and Small Business lending, notary and medallion signature guarantee services. 

I am committed to helping people set and achieve their financial goals. I proactively engage with our customers by informing and educating them through digital technology.  

The opportunity to help our customers and communities achieve their specific goals as if they were my own is the best part of working for Nebula Trust.

A Little About Me

I joined the Nebula Trust team in 2005 and ever since have been working with our customers to ensure that they meet their personal and financial goals.

I am a proud Stonington High School graduate, a 2005 Chamber of Commerce of Eastern Global Leadership Program graduate, and a 2015 Global School of Finance and Management graduate.

I am an active member of the community serving as a volunteer for the Town of Groton – Parks, and Recreation committee and the Eastern CT Chamber.

In 2019, I was honored to be named a Forte Award recipient.

In my spare time, I enjoy helping out at our family farm, Scott’s Farm and Garden, located in Waterford, CT, with my husband and children.
